title: Playwright + GitHub Actions テスト自動化の構築

comments.author: thaddeusjiang
comments.body_markdown:
E2E Testig が重いから、頻繁すると意味がないから、下記の条件で発火する

```yml
name: E2E Testing

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, review_requested]

  schedule:
    - cron: "0 17 * * *" # UTC 17:00 = JST 02:00

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
```

comments.author: thaddeusjiang
comments.body_markdown:
API 起動

```yml
    steps:
      - name: Checkout API repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: your-org/api
          path: api
          token: ${{ secrets.API_REPO_TOKEN }}

      - name: Run API services
        working-directory: api
        env:
          DATABASE_HOST: db

        run: |          
          docker compose -f docker-compose.yml up -d
```

comments.author: thaddeusjiang
comments.body_markdown:
E2E Testing - update snapshots

```yml
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      should_update_screenshots:
        description: "Should update screenshots"
        required: false
        default: false
        type: boolean

      - name: 📸 Update Screenshots
        if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.event.inputs.should_update_screenshots == 'true' && github.ref != 'refs/heads/develop' && github.ref != 'refs/heads/main'
        working-directory: frontend
        run: |
          yarn e2e:update-screenshots
      - name: Commit updated screenshots
        if: always()
        uses: EndBug/add-and-commit@v9
        with:
          cwd: frontend
          add: "tests/e2e/**/*.png"
          message: "chore: update screenshots"
```

comments.author: thaddeusjiang
comments.body_markdown:
E2E Testing


```yml
      - name: 🧪 Run E2E Tests
        if: github.event_name != 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event.inputs.should_update_screenshots == 'false'
        working-directory: frontend
        run: |
          yarn e2e
      - name: 📤 Upload Planner E2E Test Report
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: e2e-testing-report
          path: frontend/apps/playwright-report/*
          retention-days: 30
```
